business_summary: GC Medical Science Corporation operates as a diagnostic medical device company in the vitro diagnostic industry in South Korea and internationally. The company's products include human healthcare products for the diagnosis of diabetes, non-communicable diseases, respiratory diseases, and vector borne diseases. It offers CERA-CHEK 1Code and CERA-CHEK 1070 for diabetes; GREENCARE A1c for HbA1c, CERA-CHEK 3 in 1 GHL for multi-diagnosis; CERA-CHEK Lactate; GREENCARE Hb and CERA-CHEK Hb Plus for haemoglobin; and GCare Lipid and GCare Lipid Printer for cholesterol. The company also offers Covid-19 and flu diagnosis equipment including GENEDIA W Covid-19 Ag, GreenCare FLU2 Influenza A&B Ag, and 	GENEDIA W Covid-19 & Flu A&B Ag. Additionally, it offers dengue diagnosis equipment including GENEDIA W Dengue NS1 Ag, GENEDIA W Dengue lgM/lgG Ab, and GENEDIA W Dengue NS1 & lgM/lgG Combo. Further, the company provides vet healthcare products, such as CERA-PET blood glucose monitoring system for diabetes; and CERA-PET Multi for non-communicable diseases diagnosis. The company was formerly known as Green Cross Medical Science Corporation and changed its name to GC Medical Science Corporation in May 2026. GC Medical Science Corporation was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Yongin-Si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: GC녹십자메디칼사이언스(주)는 국내 및 해외 체외진단 산업 분야의 진단의료기기 기업으로 활동하고 있습니다. 이 회사의 제품에는 당뇨병, 비전염성 질환, 호흡기 질환 및 벡터 매개 질환 진단을 위한 인체 건강 관리 제품이 포함됩니다. 당뇨병을 위한 CERA-CHEK 1Code 및 CERA-CHEK 1070을 제공합니다. HbA1c를 위한 GREENCARE A1c, 다중 진단을 위한 CERA-CHEK 3 in 1 GHL; CERA-CHEK 젖산염; 헤모글로빈을 위한 GREENCARE Hb 및 CERA-CHEK Hb Plus; 콜레스테롤 측정을 위한 GCare Lipid 및 GCare Lipid 프린터. 이 회사는 또한 GENEDIA W Covid-19 Ag, GreenCare FLU2 Influenza A&B Ag, GENEDIA W Covid-19 & Flu A&B Ag 등 코로나19 및 독감 진단 장비도 제공합니다. 또한 GENEDIA W Dengue NS1 Ag, GENEDIA W Dengue lgM/lgG Ab, GENEDIA W Dengue NS1 & lgM/lgG Combo 등의 뎅기열 진단 장비도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 당뇨병용 CERA-PET 혈당 모니터링 시스템과 같은 수의사 의료 제품을 제공합니다. 비전염성 질환 진단을 위한 CERA-PET Multi. 예전에는 녹십자의과학(주)로 사명을 M에서 GC의료과학(주)로 변경하였습니다.
